common.tagline: Understand your food. Build better habits.
common.catalogCount: {{count}} sourced foods in the starter catalog

toast.cleared: Profile and diary deleted from this browser.

welcome.title: Discover what your body needs — one simple step at a time.
welcome.body: Search foods, read what nutrients do, and build a day of meals without an account.
welcome.heroAlt: Illustrated bowl of fruit and greens

onboarding.ageError: Enter a whole age from 2 to 120.
onboarding.heightError: Enter a height between 50 and 250 cm.
onboarding.weightError: Enter a weight between 10 and 350 kg.
onboarding.genderNote: Gender is not used to calculate BMI.
onboarding.prefsTitle: What would you like to explore?

sitting.title: Mostly sitting
sitting.body: Much of the day is seated, with little planned movement.

some.title: Some movement
some.body: You walk or move around, without hard training most days.

regular.title: Regularly active
regular.body: You exercise or do physical work on many days.

very.title: Very active
very.body: Hard training or a physically demanding job most days.

onboarding.restrictionsNote: You can skip this. Filters use known ingredients only and cannot promise a food is safe for an allergy.
onboarding.estimateBody: This uses the Mifflin–St Jeor equation plus your activity description. It needs a sex-based equation input, which is not the same as gender identity. You can skip it. It is not a target for losing weight, and it is not calculated from BMI.
onboarding.estimateMissing: Choose the equation input and an activity level first. Otherwise there is no estimate.
onboarding.estimateResult: Rough estimate of daily energy intake
onboarding.estimateAssumptions: Mifflin–St Jeor, activity factor {{factor}}, equation input: {{sex}}.

goalHelp.balanced: A practical start is a protein food, a grain or starchy food, and vegetables at meals.
goalHelp.maintain: Regular meals you enjoy are a steadier path than a strict rule based on BMI.
goalHelp.strength: Protein foods such as eggs, yogurt, beans, and fish can sit beside your usual meals.
goalHelp.weight: This app will not set a deficit or a goal weight from BMI alone.
goalHelp.learn: The nutrient pages explain one idea at a time, with foods that actually contain it.

bmi.label: BMI
bmi.formula: BMI = weight (kg) ÷ height (m)². It is a screening measure, not a diagnosis.
bmi.limit: BMI cannot tell body composition, health, or whether someone should lose or gain weight.
bmi.noTarget: NutriLab does not calculate an ideal weight or a weight-loss promise from BMI.
bmi.notAdult: Adult BMI categories are for ages 20 and older. Weight in children and teens needs different charts and a qualified professional. No target weight or calorie deficit is shown.

categories.obesity: Obesity range — a screening label, not a judgment

dashboard.intro: Your basics, today's log, and a few places to look next.
dashboard.finishSetup: Add your basics to personalize this page
dashboard.noProfile: No profile yet. You can still search foods and recipes.
dashboard.focusEmpty: Choose a habit to explore when you are ready.
dashboard.focusHelp: There is no single correct goal from BMI alone.
dashboard.estimate: Rough estimated intake you accepted: {{kcal}} kcal. This is not a calorie budget to finish.

foods.title: Foods
foods.intro: Search in Arabic, French, or English. The local catalog answers immediately. Remote databases run only when you ask.
foods.remoteHint: Local results stay available if a remote database is down or the API key is missing.
foods.remoteError: The remote search did not finish. Your local foods are still listed above.

remoteErrors.missing_key: USDA search needs a server API key. Open Food Facts may still respond.
remoteErrors.rate_limited: The remote search is pausing to respect rate limits.
remoteErrors.off_failed: Open Food Facts did not respond.
remoteErrors.off_rate_limited: Open Food Facts asked us to slow down.
remoteErrors.upstream: A remote database returned an error.

foods.empty: No local foods match that search.
foods.missing: That food is not in the catalog on this device.
foods.untranslated: This name is shown in the source language. It was not translated.
foods.disclaimer: Approximate nutrition — actual products and portions vary. A picture does not verify the numbers. Missing values are not reported, not zero.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.intro: Each idea uses weighed ingredients from the catalog. Calories are per serving and are estimates when cooking changes water or weight.
recipes.protein: Protein-rich (15 g or more per serving)
recipes.completeEnergy: Energy is complete for the listed ingredients
recipes.incomplete: Incomplete — a missing value was not treated as zero
recipes.scaleNote: Changing servings scales the ingredient weights. Calories per serving stay the same.
recipes.allergenLimit: This cannot guarantee the absence of allergens or cross-contact.
recipes.estimate: Figures are estimates from ingredient weights. Cooking loss, water, and unlisted spices are not fully modeled.

nutrients.title: Nutrient explorer
nutrients.intro: Twelve nutrients, explained simply. Food lists use only values present in the catalog.
nutrients.missing: That nutrient page is not available.
nutrients.needsVary: Needs vary by age and circumstances. This is not a personal deficiency test.
nutrients.commonFoods: Highest amounts in this catalog, per 100 g
nutrients.few: Only {{count}} catalog foods report a positive amount. Search foods if you want to look further.
nutrients.unspecifiedBody: USDA reports PUFA 18:3 for these foods without the specific ALA name. They are listed separately and are not added into ALA, EPA, or DHA.

diary.title: My day
diary.intro: Foods and recipes you add stay in this browser. An empty day stays empty.
diary.incomplete: Some items did not report this value.
diary.versusEstimate: You accepted a rough estimated intake of {{kcal}} kcal. Logged calories are not a remaining-calorie target.
diary.empty: Nothing is logged for this date.

settings.title: Settings
settings.profileReady: Your basics are saved on this device.
settings.privacyBody: Age, height, weight, and your diary stay in this browser for this version. They are not sent to food search services. Only the food words you submit for a remote search leave the device.
settings.sourcesBody: Starter foods are USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy values, per 100 g, public domain. Packaged remote results, when a search succeeds, come from Open Food Facts and stay attributed to that project.
settings.photos: Food and recipe photographs are from Wikimedia Commons. The line under each picture names the photographer and the license. A photograph does not change the USDA numbers.
settings.limits: NutriLab is for learning. It does not diagnose, prescribe a diet, or promise weight change.
settings.laterBody: Accounts, barcode scan, weekly planner, favorites, and personalized medical targets are not built yet.
settings.clearBody: This removes your profile and diary from this browser. Language stays as you set it.

notFound.title: That page is not here
notFound.body: The link may be mistyped. You can go back to the start.

nutrientNames.proteinG: Protein — helps build and repair your body
